m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I came in here to get away from it all! Who are all of you?
A Wizard, a Rat, and a hooded stranger walk into the Recluse Chamber? Sounds like the set-up to a bad joke!
With these Crystals, I unweave the spells that tangled up your spirit, Captain. I remove the Shadow on your heart.
And I free you of your service. Go forth, live your own life, and be gone from here.
The Mariner, whose eye is bright, whose beard with age is hoar, is gone.
Hrum. He will live a natural life now, to make of it what he will.
And it gives me a mote of my power back.
We must travel up higher. Back to the Warp and the Weft, the center of all things.
There is a small cavern there, the Recluse Chamber. A place of contemplation and focus. We need the Spinner Crystals inside.
I will lead the way, I will!
Follow the Captain to the Recluse Chamber. He is eager to see this through.
